protocol.dualTeacher: existing MinimaxAI depth=1, up to20 candidates
protocol.hexTeacher: own-relative one-step coverage/reach utility with next-seat greedy reply; top4 candidates
protocol.candidateDistribution: all legal moves; teacher top4 (dual top20) soft targets, all unselected legal moves receive zero target; training and heldout normalize over the full legal action set
protocol.splitUnit: whole generation episode, disjoint deterministic seed IDs
protocol.evidenceTier: application-pilot; imitation evaluation, not a win-rate or strength claim

training.evidence_tier: application-pilot; imitation evaluation, not a win-rate or strength claim
training.evaluation_action_set: full legal action set; same normalization as deployed policy
training.target_distribution: soft distribution on teacher-selected top4 actions (dual pretrain top20), zero elsewhere

resume: Repeat same command/run-root. Source/config drift and corrupt checkpoints fail closed.
stop: Create STOP or PAUSE in run-root; observed at each episode/epoch boundary. Remove explicitly before resuming.
limitation: Short truncated trajectory imitation pilot, no game-strength claim. Sizes10–15 are inference compatibility, not trained-size evidence.
